######## code_node_1OvNTk9G [code-node] Guard: optional job_id, session tenant, this run's lease owner WRK|<nonce>
// GD_ASYNC_WORKER - Guard: optional job_id (digits: this job only), session tenant, this run's lease owner WRK|<nonce>
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-async.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-async.mjs (+ scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs) - edit there.
// Quartz-invoked (one disabled-by-default WorkflowJob row per tenant): drains up to 10 due jobs per tick in a loop
// (budget: no new job after 20 s of the run start). Ownership of a job = the CLAIM GATE: one add-node unique
// insert of gd_publish_step W0_CLAIM_<row_version> (a twin's insert fails and its run dies before it writes the
// job); the lease WRK|<nonce> is the liveness timer. Calls GD_BULK_PREPARE then GD_BULK_COMMIT through workflow nodes,
// maps every result from the job ROW (the callee's response is evidence only) and writes GD business rows never
// (gd_async_job + its own gd_publish_step rows only).
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {};
const workerGuard = function workerGuard(input) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const inp = input || {};
  const jobId = s(inp.jobId) || "0";
  const tenantId = s(inp.systemTenantId);
  const nonce = (s(inp.uuid).replace(/[^0-9a-fA-F]/g, "").toLowerCase() + "000000000000000000000000").slice(0, 24);
  const bad = (why) => ({ route: "REJECT", jobId: "0", tenantId: "0", nonce: nonce, leaseOwner: "WRK|" + nonce, one: 1, result_code: "GD_INVALID_DATA", result_message: why });
  if (!/^[0-9]{1,20}$/.test(jobId)) return bad("job_id: digits only (or empty to poll)");
  if (!/^[0-9]{1,20}$/.test(tenantId)) return bad("no session tenant");
  return { route: "CONTINUE", jobId: jobId, tenantId: tenantId, nonce: nonce, leaseOwner: "WRK|" + nonce, one: 1, result_code: "", result_message: "" };
};
const res = workerGuard({ jobId: [{{workflowparams:job_id}}][0], systemTenantId: [{{system:tenantId}}][0], uuid: [{{system:uuid}}][0] });
console.log("worker guard", JSON.stringify(res));
return res;

######## code_node_KEQqj9tO [code-node] Evidence REJECTED_INPUT
// GD_ASYNC_WORKER - Evidence (REJECTED_INPUT)
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-async.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-async.mjs (+ scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs) - edit there.
// Quartz-invoked (one disabled-by-default WorkflowJob row per tenant): drains up to 10 due jobs per tick in a loop
// (budget: no new job after 20 s of the run start). Ownership of a job = the CLAIM GATE: one add-node unique
// insert of gd_publish_step W0_CLAIM_<row_version> (a twin's insert fails and its run dies before it writes the
// job); the lease WRK|<nonce> is the liveness timer. Calls GD_BULK_PREPARE then GD_BULK_COMMIT through workflow nodes,
// maps every result from the job ROW (the callee's response is evidence only) and writes GD business rows never
// (gd_async_job + its own gd_publish_step rows only).
// The engine stores only nodes whose output a later node references (docs/lowcode/inventory-operation-v2/evidence/engine-probe-run-2026-09-30.md F11): this node references the
// decision node of every step of its path (their route fields only), and the return node returns it. The loop's
// inner decisions are never read from outside the loop: the job rows read back after it are the truth.
const workerResult = function workerResult(guard, plan, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.id));
  const byId = {};
  for (const r of list) byId[s(r.id)] = r;
  const jobs = (plan.items || []).map((it) => {
    const j = byId[it.jobId] || null;
    return { job_id: it.jobId, before: it.jobStatus, job_status: j ? s(j.job_status) : "", error_code: j ? s(j.error_code) : "", gd_id: j ? s(j.gd_id) : "", gd_status: j ? s(j.gd_status) : "", attempt_count: j ? s(j.attempt_count) : "", lease_owner: j ? s(j.lease_owner) : "" };
  });
  const first = jobs[0] || null;
  const route = guard.route === "REJECT" ? "REJECTED" : plan.route === "IDLE" ? "IDLE" : "WORKED";
  const firstRow = first ? byId[first.job_id] || null : null;
  return { worker_route: route, processed: String(jobs.length), jobs: JSON.stringify(jobs), job_id: first ? first.job_id : "", job_status: first ? first.job_status : "", result_code: firstRow && s(firstRow.error_code) ? s(firstRow.error_code) : s(guard.result_code), result_message: firstRow && s(firstRow.error_message) ? s(firstRow.error_message) : s(guard.result_message) || s(plan.result_message), gd_id: first ? first.gd_id : "", gd_status: first ? first.gd_status : "", attempt_count: first ? first.attempt_count : "", lease_owner: first ? first.lease_owner : "" };
};
const T = (v) => String(v === undefined || v === null ? "" : v).replace(/^"([\s\S]*)"$/, "$1").trim();
const steps = {};
steps.guard = T([{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.route}}][0]);
const guard = [{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data}}][0];
const plan = { route: "IDLE", items: [], result_message: "" };
const rows = [] || [];
const r = workerResult(guard, plan, rows);
const evidence = { v: 1, workflow: "GD_ASYNC_WORKER", path: "REJECTED_INPUT", steps: steps };
return Object.assign(r, { evidence: JSON.stringify(evidence) });

######## sql_node_RaVfenlh [sql-node] Poll: the due GD-create jobs (command CREATE_GD_FROM_FORM) of the tenant (at most 10, earliest created; lease expired or never set; backoff over; AWAITING_CONFIRMATION only when a confirmation made it due; a live claim row excludes the job) + DB clock
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       x.id,
       x.organization_id,
       x.plant_id,
       x.job_status,
       x.progress_percent,
       x.progress_message,
       x.attempt_count,
       x.next_attempt_at,
       x.lease_owner,
       x.lease_expires_at,
       x.dead_lease,
       x.cancel_requested,
       x.row_version,
       x.error_code,
       x.error_message,
       x.error_details,
       x.gd_id,
       x.gd_no,
       x.claim_id,
       x.claim_started_at,
       x.claim_owner
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
                    j.organization_id,
                    j.plant_id,
                    j.job_status,
                    j.progress_percent,
                    j.progress_message,
                    j.attempt_count,
                    DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at,
                    j.lease_owner,
                    DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
                    (j.lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND j.lease_owner <> '' AND j.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND j.lease_expires_at <= NOW(3)) AS dead_lease,
                    j.cancel_requested,
                    j.row_version,
                    j.error_code,
                    j.error_message,
                    j.error_details,
                    CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
                    j.gd_no,
                    CAST(c.id AS CHAR) AS claim_id,
                    DATE_FORMAT(c.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS claim_started_at,
                    c.result_ref AS claim_owner,
                    j.create_time AS created
               FROM gd_async_job j
               LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step c
                 ON c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
                AND c.job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
                AND c.step_name = (CONCAT('W0_CLAIM_', j.row_version) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
                AND c.is_deleted = 0
               LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT op.source_job_id AS job_ref,
                                 op.organization_id AS org_ref
                            FROM inventory_operation op
                           WHERE op.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
                             AND op.is_deleted = 0
                             AND op.source_job_id <> ''
                             AND op.operation_status IN ('RECEIVED', 'VALIDATING', 'LOCKING', 'LOCKED', 'MUTATING', 'VERIFYING', 'DONE', 'REJECTED', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')
                             AND op.lease_expires_at > NOW(3)) o
                 ON o.job_ref = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
                AND o.org_ref = j.organization_id
              WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
                AND j.is_deleted = 0
                AND j.command = 'CREATE_GD_FROM_FORM'
                AND ({{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.jobId}} = 0 OR j.id = {{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.jobId}})
                AND j.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'CALCULATING', 'AWAITING_CONFIRMATION', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_GD')
                AND (j.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR j.lease_expires_at <= NOW(3))
                AND ((j.job_status <> 'AWAITING_CONFIRMATION' AND (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= NOW(3)))
                     OR (j.job_status = 'AWAITING_CONFIRMATION' AND j.next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL AND j.next_attempt_at <= NOW(3)))
                AND (c.id IS NULL OR c.started_at <= NOW(3) - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)
                AND (j.job_status <> 'COMMITTING_GD' OR o.job_ref IS NULL)
              ORDER BY j.create_time, j.id
              LIMIT 10) x
    ON 1 = 1

######## code_node_JsJ91wA5 [code-node] Plan: the loop's items (the due jobs with their claim facts), the run start
// GD_ASYNC_WORKER - Plan: the due jobs (at most 10) with their claim facts -> the loop's items, the run start
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-async.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-async.mjs (+ scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs) - edit there.
// Quartz-invoked (one disabled-by-default WorkflowJob row per tenant): drains up to 10 due jobs per tick in a loop
// (budget: no new job after 20 s of the run start). Ownership of a job = the CLAIM GATE: one add-node unique
// insert of gd_publish_step W0_CLAIM_<row_version> (a twin's insert fails and its run dies before it writes the
// job); the lease WRK|<nonce> is the liveness timer. Calls GD_BULK_PREPARE then GD_BULK_COMMIT through workflow nodes,
// maps every result from the job ROW (the callee's response is evidence only) and writes GD business rows never
// (gd_async_job + its own gd_publish_step rows only).
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {};
const claimGateClosed = function claimGateClosed(row) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  if (String(row.claim_live) === "1") return "a live worker claim row " + "W0_CLAIM_" + s(row.row_version) + " of " + s(row.claim_owner);
  if (String(row.rclaim_live) === "1") return "a live reconcile claim row " + "R0_CLAIM_" + s(row.row_version) + " of " + s(row.rclaim_owner);
  return "";
};
const workerItem = function workerItem(row) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const dead = String(row.dead_lease) === "1";
  const claimed = s(row.claim_id) !== "";
  return { jobId: s(row.id), organizationId: s(row.organization_id), jobStatus: s(row.job_status), progressPercent: Number(row.progress_percent) || 0, progressMessage: s(row.progress_message), attempts: Number(row.attempt_count) || 0, nextAttemptAt: row.next_attempt_at || null, leaseOwner: row.lease_owner || null, leaseExpiresAt: row.lease_expires_at || null, deadLease: dead ? "YES" : "NO", deadOwner: dead ? s(row.lease_owner) : "", deadClaim: claimed && String(row.claim_live) !== "1" ? "YES" : "NO", claimOwner: claimed ? s(row.claim_owner) : "", rowVersion: Number(row.row_version) || 0, errorCode: row.error_code || null, errorMessage: row.error_message || null, errorDetails: row.error_details || null, leaseLive: String(row.lease_live) === "1" ? "YES" : "NO", dueNow: String(row.due_now) === "1" ? "YES" : "NO", gateClosed: claimGateClosed(row), opLive: String(row.op_live) === "1" ? "YES" : "NO" };
};
const workerPlan = function workerPlan(guard, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r);
  const dbNow = list.length ? s(list[0].db_now) : "";
  const jobs = list.filter((r) => s(r.id));
  const items = jobs.map(workerItem);
  const ids = items.map((i) => i.jobId).filter((x) => /^[0-9]{1,20}$/.test(x));
  return { route: items.length ? "WORK" : "IDLE", dbNow: dbNow, runStart: dbNow, items: items, count: items.length, jobIdsSql: ids.length ? ids.join(",") : "0", result_code: "", result_message: items.length ? items.length + " due job(s)" : "no due job" };
};
const guard = [{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data}}][0];
const res = workerPlan(guard, [{{node:sql_node_RaVfenlh.data}}][0]);
console.log("worker plan", JSON.stringify({ route: res.route, count: res.count, jobs: res.items.map((i) => i.jobId + ":" + i.jobStatus + (i.deadLease === "YES" ? ":deadLease" : "") + (i.deadClaim === "YES" ? ":deadClaim" : "")) }));
return res;

######## sql_node_oAHg7l6A [sql-node] Tick: the FRESH read of the planned jobs (state, lease, backoff, both claim rows for the current row_version) + the DB clock (the budget) and the lease end of a claim made now
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.organization_id,
       j.job_status,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.progress_message,
       j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at,
       j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       (j.lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND j.lease_owner <> '' AND j.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND j.lease_expires_at <= n.t) AS dead_lease,
       ((j.job_status <> 'AWAITING_CONFIRMATION' AND (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= n.t))
        OR (j.job_status = 'AWAITING_CONFIRMATION' AND j.next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL AND j.next_attempt_at <= n.t)) AS due_now,
       j.row_version,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       j.error_details,
       CAST(cw.id AS CHAR) AS claim_id,
       DATE_FORMAT(cw.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS claim_started_at,
       cw.result_ref AS claim_owner,
       (cw.id IS NOT NULL AND cw.started_at > n.t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS claim_live,
       CAST(cr.id AS CHAR) AS rclaim_id,
       cr.result_ref AS rclaim_owner,
       (cr.id IS NOT NULL AND cr.started_at > n.t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS rclaim_live,
       (o.job_ref IS NOT NULL) AS op_live
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.is_deleted = 0
   AND j.id IN ({{node:code_node_JsJ91wA5.data.jobIdsSql}})
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step cw
    ON cw.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
   AND cw.job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
   AND cw.step_name = (CONCAT('W0_CLAIM_', j.row_version) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
   AND cw.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step cr
    ON cr.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
   AND cr.job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
   AND cr.step_name = (CONCAT('R0_CLAIM_', j.row_version) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
   AND cr.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT op.source_job_id AS job_ref,
                    op.organization_id AS org_ref
               FROM inventory_operation op
              WHERE op.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'

######## code_node_Qo8Suk1M [code-node] Pick: the item by index from the fresh read; SKIP after the budget, when no longer due, or while a worker / reconcile claim row is live; the claim gate rows (dead claim -> row_version + 1 first)
// GD_ASYNC_WORKER - Pick: this iteration's job (the cache index) from the tick's FRESH read, the budget, the due check, the claim gate rows (a dead claim: row_version = v + 1 first, then the claim row W0_CLAIM_<row_version>)
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-async.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-async.mjs (+ scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs) - edit there.
// Quartz-invoked (one disabled-by-default WorkflowJob row per tenant): drains up to 10 due jobs per tick in a loop
// (budget: no new job after 20 s of the run start). Ownership of a job = the CLAIM GATE: one add-node unique
// insert of gd_publish_step W0_CLAIM_<row_version> (a twin's insert fails and its run dies before it writes the
// job); the lease WRK|<nonce> is the liveness timer. Calls GD_BULK_PREPARE then GD_BULK_COMMIT through workflow nodes,
// maps every result from the job ROW (the callee's response is evidence only) and writes GD business rows never
// (gd_async_job + its own gd_publish_step rows only).
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle
const GDC = {"retry":{"max_retries":3,"base_delay_ms":2000,"max_delay_ms":30000},"worker_budget_seconds":20};
const claimGateClosed = function claimGateClosed(row) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  if (String(row.claim_live) === "1") return "a live worker claim row " + "W0_CLAIM_" + s(row.row_version) + " of " + s(row.claim_owner);
  if (String(row.rclaim_live) === "1") return "a live reconcile claim row " + "R0_CLAIM_" + s(row.row_version) + " of " + s(row.rclaim_owner);
  return "";
};
const workerItem = function workerItem(row) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const dead = String(row.dead_lease) === "1";
  const claimed = s(row.claim_id) !== "";
  return { jobId: s(row.id), organizationId: s(row.organization_id), jobStatus: s(row.job_status), progressPercent: Number(row.progress_percent) || 0, progressMessage: s(row.progress_message), attempts: Number(row.attempt_count) || 0, nextAttemptAt: row.next_attempt_at || null, leaseOwner: row.lease_owner || null, leaseExpiresAt: row.lease_expires_at || null, deadLease: dead ? "YES" : "NO", deadOwner: dead ? s(row.lease_owner) : "", deadClaim: claimed && String(row.claim_live) !== "1" ? "YES" : "NO", claimOwner: claimed ? s(row.claim_owner) : "", rowVersion: Number(row.row_version) || 0, errorCode: row.error_code || null, errorMessage: row.error_message || null, errorDetails: row.error_details || null, leaseLive: String(row.lease_live) === "1" ? "YES" : "NO", dueNow: String(row.due_now) === "1" ? "YES" : "NO", gateClosed: claimGateClosed(row), opLive: String(row.op_live) === "1" ? "YES" : "NO" };
};
const workerPick = function workerPick(guard, plan, tickRows, indexRaw) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const rows = (Array.isArray(tickRows) ? tickRows : tickRows ? [tickRows] : []).filter((r) => r);
  const tick = rows[0] || {};
  const dbNow = s(tick.db_now) || s(plan.dbNow);
  const leaseUntil = s(tick.lease_until);
  const index = indexRaw === undefined || indexRaw === null || indexRaw === "" ? 0 : parseInt(String(indexRaw), 10) || 0;
  const planned = (plan.items || [])[index] || null;
  const t = (x) => {
    const m = String(x || "").match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})/);
    return m ? Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3]), Number(m[4]), Number(m[5]), Number(m[6])) : NaN;
  };
  const elapsed = isNaN(t(plan.runStart)) || isNaN(t(dbNow)) ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.round((t(dbNow) - t(plan.runStart)) / 1000));
  const base = { route: "SKIP", index: index, nextIndex: index + 1, dbNow: dbNow, leaseUntil: leaseUntil, elapsed: elapsed, jobId: "0", organizationId: "0", item: null, rvBase: 0, rvRows: [], needRvUpd: "NO", claimName: "", claimRows: [], needClaimAdd: "NO", result_message: "" };
  if (!planned) return Object.assign(base, { result_message: "no item at index " + index });
  const fresh = rows.filter((r) => s(r.id) === planned.jobId)[0] || null;
  if (!fresh) return Object.assign(base, { jobId: planned.jobId, organizationId: planned.organizationId, result_message: "job " + planned.jobId + " is gone from the fresh read: skipped" });
  const item = workerItem(fresh);
  const out = Object.assign(base, { jobId: item.jobId, organizationId: item.organizationId, item: item });
  if (index > 0 && elapsed > GDC.worker_budget_seconds) return Object.assign(out, { result_message: "budget: " + elapsed + " s since the run start (> " + GDC.worker_budget_seconds + " s): job " + item.jobId + " is left for the next tick" });
  const workerStates = ["QUEUED", "VALIDATING", "CALCULATING", "AWAITING_CONFIRMATION", "READY_TO_COMMIT", "COMMITTING_GD"];
  if (workerStates.indexOf(item.jobStatus) < 0) return Object.assign(out, { result_message: "job " + item.jobId + " is " + item.jobStatus + " now (polled " + planned.jobStatus + "): skipped" });
  if (item.leaseLive === "YES") return Object.assign(out, { result_message: "job " + item.jobId + " has a live lease of " + s(item.leaseOwner) + " now: skipped" });
  if (item.dueNow !== "YES") return Object.assign(out, { result_message: "job " + item.jobId + " is not due now (next_attempt_at " + s(item.nextAttemptAt) + "): skipped" });
  // 2026-10-02 (no line maximum): the commit's inventory call may outlast the job lease; while an inventory operation
  // of the job (not REJECTED / REQUIRES_REVIEW) holds a live lease - its run renews it at every stage - the job is not
  // re-claimed
  if (item.jobStatus === "COMMITTING_GD" && item.opLive === "YES") return Object.assign(out, { result_message: "job " + item.jobId + " is COMMITTING_GD and its inventory operation holds a live lease (the commit's call is still running): skipped" });
  if (item.gateClosed) return Object.assign(out, { result_message: "job " + item.jobId + ": " + item.gateClosed + " - skipped" });
  const rv = item.rowVersion;
  const dead = item.deadClaim === "YES";
  const rvBase = dead ? rv + 1 : rv;
  const name = "W0_CLAIM_" + rvBase;
  // a dead claim is one retry, counted in the same absolute write (a run that dies between its claim insert and its
  // lease write would otherwise never be counted); never above max_retries
  const counted = dead ? Math.min(item.attempts + 1, GDC.retry.max_retries) : item.attempts;
  return Object.assign(out, { route: "CLAIM", rvBase: rvBase, rvRows: dead ? [{ id: item.jobId, row_version: rvBase, attempt_count: counted }] : [], needRvUpd: dead ? "YES" : "NO", claimName: name, claimRows: [{ job_id: item.jobId, organization_id: item.organizationId, step_name: name, step_status: "DONE", attempt_count: 1, started_at: dbNow, inventory_operation_id: "", result_ref: guard.leaseOwner, error_code: null, error_message: null }], needClaimAdd: "YES", result_message: (rv !== planned.rowVersion ? "row_version moved " + planned.rowVersion + " -> " + rv + " since the poll; " : "") + (dead ? "dead claim of " + item.claimOwner + " moved past (row_version " + rv + " -> " + rvBase + ", retry " + counted + "); " : "") + "claim " + name });
};

    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));

const workerClaim = function workerClaim(guard, pick) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const item = pick.item;
  const base = { route: "SKIP", dbNow: pick.dbNow, jobId: pick.jobId, jobStatus: item ? item.jobStatus : "", organizationId: pick.organizationId, rowVersion: pick.rvBase, attempts: item ? item.attempts : 0, deadLease: item ? item.deadLease : "NO", deadClaim: item ? item.deadClaim : "NO", claimRows: [], needClaim: "NO", failRows: [], exhausted: "NO", result_code: "", result_message: pick.result_message, job_status: item ? item.jobStatus : "" };
  if (pick.route !== "CLAIM" || !item) return base;
  const status = item.jobStatus;
  const dead = item.deadLease === "YES" || item.deadClaim === "YES";
  const attempts = item.attempts; // as polled: a dead claim's retry was written by the pick's absolute write already
  const rv = pick.rvBase;
  const exhausted = dead && attempts >= GDC.retry.max_retries;
  const counted = dead && !exhausted ? attempts + 1 : attempts;
  const row = { id: item.jobId, job_status: status, progress_percent: item.progressPercent, progress_message: item.progressMessage, attempt_count: counted, next_attempt_at: item.nextAttemptAt, lease_owner: item.leaseOwner, lease_expires_at: item.leaseExpiresAt, row_version: rv + 1, error_code: item.errorCode, error_message: item.errorMessage, error_details: item.errorDetails, finished_at: null };
  const why = (dead ? "dead " + (item.deadLease === "YES" ? "lease of " + item.deadOwner : "claim of " + item.claimOwner) + ": " : "") + (exhausted ? "retries exhausted (" + attempts + " of " + GDC.retry.max_retries + ")" : dead ? "retry " + counted + " of " + GDC.retry.max_retries : "");
  if (status === "COMMITTING_GD") {
    const out = Object.assign(base, { attempts: counted, exhausted: exhausted ? "YES" : "NO", claimRows: dead && !exhausted ? [Object.assign({}, row, { attempt_count: counted })] : [], needClaim: dead && !exhausted ? "YES" : "NO" });
    if (exhausted) return Object.assign(out, { route: "EXHAUST", result_message: why + ": decided from the inventory operation rows" });
    return Object.assign(out, { route: "RESUME", result_message: (why ? why + "; " : "") + "resume GD_BULK_COMMIT" });
  }
  if (["QUEUED", "VALIDATING", "CALCULATING", "AWAITING_CONFIRMATION", "READY_TO_COMMIT"].indexOf(status) < 0) return Object.assign(base, { route: "SKIP", result_message: "job is " + status + ": not a worker state" });
  const toValidating = status === "QUEUED" || status === "AWAITING_CONFIRMATION";
  const claim = Object.assign({}, row, { job_status: toValidating ? "VALIDATING" : status, progress_percent: toValidating ? Math.max(item.progressPercent, GDC.progress.VALIDATING) : item.progressPercent, progress_message: toValidating ? GDC.display.VALIDATING : item.progressMessage, attempt_count: counted, lease_owner: guard.leaseOwner, lease_expires_at: pick.leaseUntil });
  const claimed = Object.assign(base, { attempts: counted, claimRows: [claim], needClaim: "YES", exhausted: exhausted ? "YES" : "NO" });
  if (exhausted) {
    const reason = "the run that owned the job died " + attempts + " times before the job was prepared / published (max_retries " + GDC.retry.max_retries + "); no business row exists for a pre-commit job";

  }
  return Object.assign(claimed, { route: status === "READY_TO_COMMIT" ? "PUBLISH" : "PREPARE", result_message: (why ? why + "; " : "") + "claim " + status + (toValidating ? " -> VALIDATING" : "") });
};

function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}

  if (!job) return Object.assign(base, { route: "LOST", result_code: "GD_INVALID_DATA", result_message: "job " + claim.jobId + " vanished after the claim" });

  const live = String(job.lease_live) === "1";

    return base;
  }
  if (s(job.lease_owner) !== guard.leaseOwner) return Object.assign(base, { route: "LOST", result_code: "JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT", result_message: "the job's lease owner is " + s(job.lease_owner) + " after this run's lease write (a run that stalled past the lease between its claim insert and its lease write: the residual window)" });
  const expect = claim.claimRows.length ? s(claim.claimRows[0].job_status) : status;
  if (status !== expect) return Object.assign(base, { route: "LOST", result_code: "JOB_ILLEGAL_TRANSITION", result_message: "job is " + status + " after the claim (expected " + expect + ")" });
  return base;

const workerExhaust = function workerExhaust(guard, own, opRows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const ops = (Array.isArray(opRows) ? opRows : opRows ? [opRows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.operation_id));
  const base = { route: "NONE", dbNow: own.dbNow, jobId: own.jobId, jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", stepRows: [], needStepUpd: "NO", stepAddRows: [], needStepAdd: "NO", result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: own.job_status };
  if (own.route !== "EXHAUST") return base;
  if (own.jobStatus !== "COMMITTING_GD") return Object.assign(base, { route: "FAILED", jobRows: own.failRows, needJobUpd: own.failRows.length ? "YES" : "NO", result_code: "GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED", result_message: own.result_message, job_status: "FAILED" });
  const p3 = own.p3;
  const live = ops.filter((o) => s(o.operation_status) !== "REJECTED");
  const dbNow = own.dbNow;
  if (!live.length) {
    const why = "retries exhausted (" + own.attempts + " of " + GDC.retry.max_retries + ") and every inventory operation of the job is " + (ops.length ? "REJECTED (" + ops.map((o) => s(o.operation_id)).join(", ") + ")" : "absent (never called)") + ": a clean failure, finished by GD_BULK_COMMIT (FINISH_FAILED)";
    const msg = GDC.codes.GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED.message + ": " + why;
    const upd = p3 ? [{ id: p3.id, step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: p3.attempt || 1, finished_at: dbNow, inventory_operation_id: p3.opId, result_ref: why.slice(0, 500), error_code: "GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED", error_message: msg }] : [];
    const add = p3 ? [] : [{ job_id: own.jobId, organization_id: own.organizationId, step_name: "P3_INVENTORY_APPLY", step_status: "FAILED", attempt_count: 1, started_at: dbNow, inventory_operation_id: "", result_ref: why.slice(0, 500), error_code: "GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED", error_message: msg }];
    return Object.assign(base, { route: "FINISH", stepRows: upd, needStepUpd: upd.length ? "YES" : "NO", stepAddRows: add, needStepAdd: add.length ? "YES" : "NO", result_code: "GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED", result_message: why });
  }
  const op = live.filter((o) => p3 && s(o.operation_id) === p3.opId)[0] || live[live.length - 1];
  const ref = s(op.review_reference) || s(op.operation_id);
  const why = "retries exhausted (" + own.attempts + " of " + GDC.retry.max_retries + ") and inventory operation " + s(op.operation_id) + " is " + s(op.operation_status) + (s(op.result_code) ? " (" + s(op.result_code) + ")" : "") + ": nothing is retried, the delivery stays hidden";
  const details = { review_reference: ref, inventory_operation_id: s(op.operation_id), inventory_result_code: s(op.result_code), step: "GD_ASYNC_WORKER", why: why, attempts: own.attempts, operations: ops.map((o) => s(o.operation_id) + ":" + s(o.operation_status)) };
  const jobRow = { id: own.jobId, job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", progress_percent: 0, progress_message: GDC.display.REQUIRES_REVIEW.replace("{review_reference}", ref), attempt_count: own.attempts, next_attempt_at: null, lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, row_version: own.rowVersion + 1, error_code: "GD_RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH", error_message: GDC.codes.GD_RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH.message + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson(details), finished_at: dbNow };
  const upd = p3 ? [{ id: p3.id, step_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", attempt_count: p3.attempt || 1, finished_at: dbNow, inventory_operation_id: p3.opId || s(op.operation_id), result_ref: p3.ref || ref, error_code: "GD_RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH", error_message: why }] : [];
  return Object.assign(base, { route: "REVIEW", jobRows: [jobRow], needJobUpd: "YES", stepRows: upd, needStepUpd: upd.length ? "YES" : "NO", result_code: "GD_RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH", result_message: why, job_status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW" });
};

// GD_ASYNC_WORKER - The prepare response, normalized
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-async.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-async.mjs (+ scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs) - edit there.
// Quartz-invoked (one disabled-by-default WorkflowJob row per tenant): drains up to 10 due jobs per tick in a loop
// (budget: no new job after 20 s of the run start). Ownership of a job = the CLAIM GATE: one add-node unique
// insert of gd_publish_step W0_CLAIM_<row_version> (a twin's insert fails and its run dies before it writes the
// job); the lease WRK|<nonce> is the liveness timer. Calls GD_BULK_PREPARE then GD_BULK_COMMIT through workflow nodes,
// maps every result from the job ROW (the callee's response is evidence only) and writes GD business rows never
// (gd_async_job + its own gd_publish_step rows only).
// The callee's return fields arrive as node:<workflow node>.data.<field> tokens; a callee that wraps its fields in
// {code, data} is read through data (Task 7A fix round 1, M2). The job ROW read right after is the truth.
const calleeEcho = function calleeEcho(raw, fields) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : typeof v === "object" ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v));
  const r0 = raw && typeof raw === "object" ? raw : {};
  const r = r0.result_code === undefined && r0.job_status === undefined && r0.data && typeof r0.data === "object" ? r0.data : r0;
  const out = { called: "YES" };
  for (const f of fields) out[f] = s(r[f]);
  return out;
};

######## sql_node_W1AEdTsn [sql-node] Read-back: the job after prepare (the truth)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.job_status,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.progress_message,
       j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at,
       j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.row_version,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       j.error_details,
       CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
       j.gd_no,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.finished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS finished_at,
       j.is_deleted,
       CAST(p3.id AS CHAR) AS p3_id,
       p3.step_status AS p3_status,
       p3.attempt_count AS p3_attempt,
       p3.inventory_operation_id AS p3_op,
       p3.result_ref AS p3_ref,
       (SELECT g.gd_status FROM goods_delivery g
         WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
           AND g.gd_dockey = CONCAT('JOB|', '{{node:code_node_Qo8Suk1M.data.jobId}}')
           AND g.is_deleted = 0
         LIMIT 1) AS gd_status
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_Qo8Suk1M.data.jobId}}
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step p3
    ON p3.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
   AND p3.job_id = '{{node:code_node_Qo8Suk1M.data.jobId}}'
   AND p3.step_name = 'P3_INVENTORY_APPLY'
   AND p3.is_deleted = 0

function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}

const dbAddSeconds = function dbAddSeconds(text, seconds) {
  const m = String(text || "").match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})/);
  if (!m) return "";
  const t = Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3]), Number(m[4]), Number(m[5]), Number(m[6])) + seconds * 1000;
  const d = new Date(t);
  const p = (n) => (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n;
  return d.getUTCFullYear() + "-" + p(d.getUTCMonth() + 1) + "-" + p(d.getUTCDate()) + " " + p(d.getUTCHours()) + ":" + p(d.getUTCMinutes()) + ":" + p(d.getUTCSeconds());
};
const calleeHardCode = function calleeHardCode(code) {
  const c = String(code || "");
  const cat = GDC.code_categories[c];
  return cat === "CONTRACT" || cat === "BUSINESS" || cat === "CONFIRMATION" ? c : "";
};
const workerAfterPrepare = function workerAfterPrepare(guard, own, resp, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r);
  const dbNow = list.length ? s(list[0].db_now) || own.dbNow : own.dbNow;
  const job = list.filter((r) => s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const r = resp || {};
  const base = { route: "END", dbNow: dbNow, jobId: own.jobId, jobStatus: job ? s(job.job_status) : "", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", prepareResult: s(r.result_code), prepareMessage: s(r.result_message), prepareStatus: s(r.job_status), result_code: "", result_message: "", job_status: job ? s(job.job_status) : "" };
  if (!job) return Object.assign(base, { result_code: "GD_INVALID_DATA", result_message: "job vanished during prepare" });
  const status = s(job.job_status);
  const ours = s(job.lease_owner) === guard.leaseOwner;
  const row = { id: s(job.id), job_status: status, progress_percent: Number(job.progress_percent) || 0, progress_message: s(job.progress_message), attempt_count: Number(job.attempt_count) || 0, next_attempt_at: job.next_attempt_at || null, lease_owner: job.lease_owner || null, lease_expires_at: job.lease_expires_at || null, row_version: (Number(job.row_version) || 0) + 1, error_code: job.error_code || null, error_message: job.error_message || null, error_details: job.error_details || null, finished_at: job.finished_at || null };
  if (status === "READY_TO_COMMIT") return Object.assign(base, { route: "PUBLISH", result_message: "prepared: " + s(r.result_message) });
  if (!ours) return Object.assign(base, { result_code: "JOB_ROW_VERSION_CONFLICT", result_message: "job is " + status + " with lease owner " + s(job.lease_owner) + " after prepare: nothing written" });
  if (status === "AWAITING_CONFIRMATION") return Object.assign(base, { jobRows: [Object.assign({}, row, { lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, next_attempt_at: null })], needJobUpd: "YES", result_code: s(job.error_code), result_message: "confirmation needed: " + s(job.error_message) + " (not due until the form submits a confirmation_hash)" });
  if (status === "FAILED" || status === "CANCELLED") return Object.assign(base, { jobRows: [Object.assign({}, row, { lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null })], needJobUpd: "YES", result_code: s(job.error_code), result_message: status + ": " + (s(job.error_message) || s(r.result_message)) });
  // VALIDATING / CALCULATING / QUEUED after a completed call
  const hard = calleeHardCode(r.result_code);
  const n = Number(job.attempt_count) || 0;
  if (hard || n >= GDC.retry.max_retries) {
    const code = hard || "GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED";
    const why = hard ? "GD_BULK_PREPARE answered " + hard + " (" + s(r.result_message) + ") and left the job " + status + ": a " + GDC.code_categories[hard] + " code, not retried" : "GD_BULK_PREPARE answered without a code and left the job " + status + " " + n + " times (max_retries " + GDC.retry.max_retries + ")";
    return Object.assign(base, { jobRows: [Object.assign({}, row, { job_status: "FAILED", progress_message: GDC.display.FAILED, error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson({ step: "GD_ASYNC_WORKER", why: why, attempts: n, prepare_result_code: s(r.result_code) }), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: dbNow })], needJobUpd: "YES", result_code: code, result_message: why, job_status: "FAILED" });
  }
  const delayMs = Math.min(GDC.retry.max_delay_ms, GDC.retry.base_delay_ms * Math.pow(2, n));
  return Object.assign(base, { jobRows: [Object.assign({}, row, { attempt_count: n + 1, next_attempt_at: dbAddSeconds(dbNow, Math.ceil(delayMs / 1000)), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null })], needJobUpd: "YES", result_code: "GD_TRANSIENT_CONNECTIVITY", result_message: "GD_BULK_PREPARE left the job " + status + " without a code: retry " + (n + 1) + " of " + GDC.retry.max_retries + " after " + delayMs + " ms" });
};
const guard = [{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data}}][0];
const own = [{{node:code_node_d1wgEEv4.data}}][0];

return res;

       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.job_status,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.progress_message,
       j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at,
       j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.row_version,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       j.error_details,
       CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
       j.gd_no,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.finished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS finished_at,
       j.is_deleted,
       CAST(p3.id AS CHAR) AS p3_id,
       p3.step_status AS p3_status,
       p3.attempt_count AS p3_attempt,
       p3.inventory_operation_id AS p3_op,
       p3.result_ref AS p3_ref,
       (SELECT g.gd_status FROM goods_delivery g
         WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
           AND g.gd_dockey = CONCAT('JOB|', '{{node:code_node_Qo8Suk1M.data.jobId}}')
           AND g.is_deleted = 0
         LIMIT 1) AS gd_status
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_Qo8Suk1M.data.jobId}}
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step p3
    ON p3.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
   AND p3.job_id = '{{node:code_node_Qo8Suk1M.data.jobId}}'
   AND p3.step_name = 'P3_INVENTORY_APPLY'
   AND p3.is_deleted = 0

function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle

  const base = { route: "END", dbNow: dbNow, jobId: own.jobId, jobStatus: job ? s(job.job_status) : "", result_message: "" };
  if (!job || ["PREPARE", "PUBLISH", "RESUME", "EXHAUST"].indexOf(own.route) < 0) return base;
  const status = s(job.job_status);
  if (own.route === "RESUME" || own.route === "EXHAUST") return status === "COMMITTING_GD" && String(job.lease_live) !== "1" ? Object.assign(base, { route: "PUBLISH", result_message: own.route === "EXHAUST" ? "finish the clean failure through GD_BULK_COMMIT (FINISH_FAILED)" : "resume GD_BULK_COMMIT" }) : Object.assign(base, { result_message: "job is " + status + (String(job.lease_live) === "1" ? " with a live lease" : "") + ": no publish call" });
  if (status === "READY_TO_COMMIT" && s(job.lease_owner) === guard.leaseOwner) return Object.assign(base, { route: "PUBLISH", result_message: "publish" });
  return Object.assign(base, { result_message: "job is " + status + " (lease " + s(job.lease_owner) + "): no publish call" });
};

// Quartz-invoked (one disabled-by-default WorkflowJob row per tenant): drains up to 10 due jobs per tick in a loop
// (budget: no new job after 20 s of the run start). Ownership of a job = the CLAIM GATE: one add-node unique
// insert of gd_publish_step W0_CLAIM_<row_version> (a twin's insert fails and its run dies before it writes the
// job); the lease WRK|<nonce> is the liveness timer. Calls GD_BULK_PREPARE then GD_BULK_COMMIT through workflow nodes,
// maps every result from the job ROW (the callee's response is evidence only) and writes GD business rows never
// (gd_async_job + its own gd_publish_step rows only).
// The callee's return fields arrive as node:<workflow node>.data.<field> tokens; a callee that wraps its fields in
// {code, data} is read through data (Task 7A fix round 1, M2). The job ROW read right after is the truth.
const calleeEcho = function calleeEcho(raw, fields) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : typeof v === "object" ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v));
  const r0 = raw && typeof raw === "object" ? raw : {};
  const r = r0.result_code === undefined && r0.job_status === undefined && r0.data && typeof r0.data === "object" ? r0.data : r0;
  const out = { called: "YES" };
  for (const f of fields) out[f] = s(r[f]);
  return out;
};

######## code_node_BpQ4eUe1 [code-node] After publish: the callee wrote the job itself; the worker writes only when it answered without writing (READY_TO_COMMIT under this run's lease)
// GD_ASYNC_WORKER - After publish: GD_BULK_COMMIT wrote the job itself (every ending releases the lease); the worker writes only when the callee answered without writing and the job is still READY_TO_COMMIT under this run's lease (a hard code -> FAILED; no code -> counted retry / FAILED when exhausted)
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-async.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-async.mjs (+ scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs) - edit there.
// Quartz-invoked (one disabled-by-default WorkflowJob row per tenant): drains up to 10 due jobs per tick in a loop
// (budget: no new job after 20 s of the run start). Ownership of a job = the CLAIM GATE: one add-node unique
// insert of gd_publish_step W0_CLAIM_<row_version> (a twin's insert fails and its run dies before it writes the
// job); the lease WRK|<nonce> is the liveness timer. Calls GD_BULK_PREPARE then GD_BULK_COMMIT through workflow nodes,
// maps every result from the job ROW (the callee's response is evidence only) and writes GD business rows never
// (gd_async_job + its own gd_publish_step rows only).
// ---- contract bundle: generated from scripts/lib/inventory-operation-v2-contract.mjs (+ docs/contracts/inventory-operation-v2-contract.json); edit it there.
const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}
// ---- end of contract bundle

const dbAddSeconds = function dbAddSeconds(text, seconds) {
  const m = String(text || "").match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})/);
  if (!m) return "";
  const t = Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3]), Number(m[4]), Number(m[5]), Number(m[6])) + seconds * 1000;
  const d = new Date(t);
  const p = (n) => (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n;
  return d.getUTCFullYear() + "-" + p(d.getUTCMonth() + 1) + "-" + p(d.getUTCDate()) + " " + p(d.getUTCHours()) + ":" + p(d.getUTCMinutes()) + ":" + p(d.getUTCSeconds());
};
const calleeHardCode = function calleeHardCode(code) {
  const c = String(code || "");
  const cat = GDC.code_categories[c];
  return cat === "CONTRACT" || cat === "BUSINESS" || cat === "CONFIRMATION" ? c : "";
};
const workerAfterPublish = function workerAfterPublish(guard, mid, resp, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r);
  const dbNow = list.length ? s(list[0].db_now) || mid.dbNow : mid.dbNow;
  const job = list.filter((r) => s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const r = resp || {};
  const base = { route: "END", dbNow: dbNow, jobId: mid.jobId, jobStatus: job ? s(job.job_status) : "", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", publishRoute: s(r.publish_route), publishResult: s(r.result_code), publishMessage: s(r.result_message), gdId: s(r.gd_id), gdStatus: s(r.gd_status), result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: job ? s(job.job_status) : "" };
  if (!job) return Object.assign(base, { result_code: "GD_INVALID_DATA", result_message: "job vanished during publish" });
  const status = s(job.job_status);
  if (!(status === "READY_TO_COMMIT" && s(job.lease_owner) === guard.leaseOwner)) return base;
  const row = { id: s(job.id), job_status: status, progress_percent: Number(job.progress_percent) || 0, progress_message: s(job.progress_message), attempt_count: Number(job.attempt_count) || 0, next_attempt_at: job.next_attempt_at || null, lease_owner: job.lease_owner || null, lease_expires_at: job.lease_expires_at || null, row_version: (Number(job.row_version) || 0) + 1, error_code: job.error_code || null, error_message: job.error_message || null, error_details: job.error_details || null, finished_at: job.finished_at || null };
  const hard = calleeHardCode(r.result_code);
  const n = Number(job.attempt_count) || 0;
  if (hard || n >= GDC.retry.max_retries) {
    const code = hard || "GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED";
    const why = hard ? "GD_BULK_COMMIT answered " + hard + " (" + s(r.result_message) + ") without publishing: a " + GDC.code_categories[hard] + " code, not retried; nothing was published" : "GD_BULK_COMMIT answered without a code and without publishing " + n + " times (max_retries " + GDC.retry.max_retries + "); nothing was published";
    return Object.assign(base, { jobRows: [Object.assign({}, row, { job_status: "FAILED", progress_message: GDC.display.FAILED, error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson({ step: "GD_ASYNC_WORKER", why: why, attempts: n, publish_result_code: s(r.result_code) }), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: dbNow })], needJobUpd: "YES", result_code: code, result_message: why, job_status: "FAILED" });
  }
  const delayMs = Math.min(GDC.retry.max_delay_ms, GDC.retry.base_delay_ms * Math.pow(2, n));
  return Object.assign(base, { jobRows: [Object.assign({}, row, { attempt_count: n + 1, next_attempt_at: dbAddSeconds(dbNow, Math.ceil(delayMs / 1000)), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null })], needJobUpd: "YES", result_code: "GD_TRANSIENT_CONNECTIVITY", result_message: "GD_BULK_COMMIT answered without a code and without publishing (" + s(r.result_message) + "): retry " + (n + 1) + " of " + GDC.retry.max_retries + " after " + delayMs + " ms" });
};

return res;

const GDC = {};
const workerSplitResume = function workerSplitResume(guard, mid, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r);
  const dbNow = list.length ? s(list[0].db_now) || mid.dbNow : mid.dbNow;
  const job = list.filter((r) => s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const base = { route: "END", dbNow: dbNow, jobId: mid.jobId, jobStatus: job ? s(job.job_status) : "", result_message: "" };
  if (s(mid.route) !== "PUBLISH" || !job) return Object.assign(base, { result_message: "no publish call in this iteration" });
  const split = s(job.job_status) === "COMMITTING_GD" && s(job.lease_owner).indexOf("SPLIT|") === 0 && !s(job.next_attempt_at);
  if (!split) return Object.assign(base, { result_message: "job is " + s(job.job_status) + (s(job.next_attempt_at) ? " (next attempt " + s(job.next_attempt_at) + ")" : "") + (s(job.lease_owner) ? " (lease " + s(job.lease_owner) + ")" : "") + ": no second publish call" });

// GD_ASYNC_WORKER - The second publish response, normalized
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-async.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-async.mjs (+ scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs) - edit there.
// Quartz-invoked (one disabled-by-default WorkflowJob row per tenant): drains up to 10 due jobs per tick in a loop
// (budget: no new job after 20 s of the run start). Ownership of a job = the CLAIM GATE: one add-node unique
// insert of gd_publish_step W0_CLAIM_<row_version> (a twin's insert fails and its run dies before it writes the
// job); the lease WRK|<nonce> is the liveness timer. Calls GD_BULK_PREPARE then GD_BULK_COMMIT through workflow nodes,
// maps every result from the job ROW (the callee's response is evidence only) and writes GD business rows never
// (gd_async_job + its own gd_publish_step rows only).
// The callee's return fields arrive as node:<workflow node>.data.<field> tokens; a callee that wraps its fields in
// {code, data} is read through data (Task 7A fix round 1, M2). The job ROW read right after is the truth.
const calleeEcho = function calleeEcho(raw, fields) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : typeof v === "object" ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v));
  const r0 = raw && typeof raw === "object" ? raw : {};
  const r = r0.result_code === undefined && r0.job_status === undefined && r0.data && typeof r0.data === "object" ? r0.data : r0;
  const out = { called: "YES" };
  for (const f of fields) out[f] = s(r[f]);
  return out;
};
const raw = [{{node:workflow_node_3ylKUgO3.data}}][0] || {};

######## sql_node_r5ReYmSs [sql-node] Read-back: the job after the second publish (the truth)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.job_status,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.progress_message,
       j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at,
       j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.row_version,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       j.error_details,
       CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
       j.gd_no,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.finished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS finished_at,
       j.is_deleted,
       CAST(p3.id AS CHAR) AS p3_id,
       p3.step_status AS p3_status,
       p3.attempt_count AS p3_attempt,
       p3.inventory_operation_id AS p3_op,
       p3.result_ref AS p3_ref,
       (SELECT g.gd_status FROM goods_delivery g
         WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
           AND g.gd_dockey = CONCAT('JOB|', '{{node:code_node_Qo8Suk1M.data.jobId}}')
           AND g.is_deleted = 0
         LIMIT 1) AS gd_status
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_Qo8Suk1M.data.jobId}}
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step p3
    ON p3.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
   AND p3.job_id = '{{node:code_node_Qo8Suk1M.data.jobId}}'
   AND p3.step_name = 'P3_INVENTORY_APPLY'
   AND p3.is_deleted = 0

// GD_ASYNC_WORKER - After the second publish: GD_BULK_COMMIT wrote the job itself; the worker writes only when the callee answered without writing and the job is still READY_TO_COMMIT under this run's lease (never after a split: the job is COMMITTING_GD)

const CONTRACT = {};
function canonicalJson(value) {
  const sort = (v) => {
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map(sort);
    if (v && typeof v === "object") {
      const out = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(v).sort()) out[k] = sort(v[k]);
      return out;
    }
    return v;
  };
  return JSON.stringify(sort(value));
}

const dbAddSeconds = function dbAddSeconds(text, seconds) {
  const m = String(text || "").match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})/);
  if (!m) return "";
  const t = Date.UTC(Number(m[1]), Number(m[2]) - 1, Number(m[3]), Number(m[4]), Number(m[5]), Number(m[6])) + seconds * 1000;
  const d = new Date(t);
  const p = (n) => (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n;
  return d.getUTCFullYear() + "-" + p(d.getUTCMonth() + 1) + "-" + p(d.getUTCDate()) + " " + p(d.getUTCHours()) + ":" + p(d.getUTCMinutes()) + ":" + p(d.getUTCSeconds());
};
const calleeHardCode = function calleeHardCode(code) {
  const c = String(code || "");
  const cat = GDC.code_categories[c];
  return cat === "CONTRACT" || cat === "BUSINESS" || cat === "CONFIRMATION" ? c : "";
};
const workerAfterPublish = function workerAfterPublish(guard, mid, resp, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r);
  const dbNow = list.length ? s(list[0].db_now) || mid.dbNow : mid.dbNow;
  const job = list.filter((r) => s(r.id))[0] || null;
  const r = resp || {};
  const base = { route: "END", dbNow: dbNow, jobId: mid.jobId, jobStatus: job ? s(job.job_status) : "", jobRows: [], needJobUpd: "NO", publishRoute: s(r.publish_route), publishResult: s(r.result_code), publishMessage: s(r.result_message), gdId: s(r.gd_id), gdStatus: s(r.gd_status), result_code: s(r.result_code), result_message: s(r.result_message), job_status: job ? s(job.job_status) : "" };
  if (!job) return Object.assign(base, { result_code: "GD_INVALID_DATA", result_message: "job vanished during publish" });
  const status = s(job.job_status);
  if (!(status === "READY_TO_COMMIT" && s(job.lease_owner) === guard.leaseOwner)) return base;
  const row = { id: s(job.id), job_status: status, progress_percent: Number(job.progress_percent) || 0, progress_message: s(job.progress_message), attempt_count: Number(job.attempt_count) || 0, next_attempt_at: job.next_attempt_at || null, lease_owner: job.lease_owner || null, lease_expires_at: job.lease_expires_at || null, row_version: (Number(job.row_version) || 0) + 1, error_code: job.error_code || null, error_message: job.error_message || null, error_details: job.error_details || null, finished_at: job.finished_at || null };
  const hard = calleeHardCode(r.result_code);
  const n = Number(job.attempt_count) || 0;
  if (hard || n >= GDC.retry.max_retries) {
    const code = hard || "GD_TRANSIENT_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED";
    const why = hard ? "GD_BULK_COMMIT answered " + hard + " (" + s(r.result_message) + ") without publishing: a " + GDC.code_categories[hard] + " code, not retried; nothing was published" : "GD_BULK_COMMIT answered without a code and without publishing " + n + " times (max_retries " + GDC.retry.max_retries + "); nothing was published";
    return Object.assign(base, { jobRows: [Object.assign({}, row, { job_status: "FAILED", progress_message: GDC.display.FAILED, error_code: code, error_message: (GDC.codes[code] ? GDC.codes[code].message : code) + ": " + why, error_details: canonicalJson({ step: "GD_ASYNC_WORKER", why: why, attempts: n, publish_result_code: s(r.result_code) }), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null, finished_at: dbNow })], needJobUpd: "YES", result_code: code, result_message: why, job_status: "FAILED" });
  }
  const delayMs = Math.min(GDC.retry.max_delay_ms, GDC.retry.base_delay_ms * Math.pow(2, n));
  return Object.assign(base, { jobRows: [Object.assign({}, row, { attempt_count: n + 1, next_attempt_at: dbAddSeconds(dbNow, Math.ceil(delayMs / 1000)), lease_owner: null, lease_expires_at: null })], needJobUpd: "YES", result_code: "GD_TRANSIENT_CONNECTIVITY", result_message: "GD_BULK_COMMIT answered without a code and without publishing (" + s(r.result_message) + "): retry " + (n + 1) + " of " + GDC.retry.max_retries + " after " + delayMs + " ms" });
};

######## sql_node_PKjob001 [sql-node] The job after both publish calls (the Picking decision; read in the loop body)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.job_status,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.progress_message,
       j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at,
       j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       j.row_version,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       j.error_details,
       CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
       j.gd_no,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.finished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS finished_at,
       j.is_deleted,
       CAST(p3.id AS CHAR) AS p3_id,
       p3.step_status AS p3_status,
       p3.attempt_count AS p3_attempt,
       p3.inventory_operation_id AS p3_op,
       p3.result_ref AS p3_ref,
       (SELECT g.gd_status FROM goods_delivery g
         WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
           AND g.gd_dockey = CONCAT('JOB|', '{{node:code_node_Qo8Suk1M.data.jobId}}')
           AND g.is_deleted = 0
         LIMIT 1) AS gd_status
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_Qo8Suk1M.data.jobId}}
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step p3
    ON p3.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
   AND p3.job_id = '{{node:code_node_Qo8Suk1M.data.jobId}}'
   AND p3.step_name = 'P3_INVENTORY_APPLY'
   AND p3.is_deleted = 0
RESP: ['db_now', 'id', 'job_status', 'progress_message', 'next_attempt_at', 'lease_owner', 'lease_expires_at', 'error_code', 'error_message', 'error_details', 'gd_id', 'gd_no', 'finished_at', 'p3_id', 'p3_status', 'p3_op', 'p3_ref', 'gd_status', 'progress_percent', 'attempt_count', 'lease_live', 'row_version', 'is_deleted', 'p3_attempt']

######## code_node_PKdec001 [code-node] Picking: the job committed in this iteration -> its GD_COMMITTED event
// GD_ASYNC_WORKER - Picking: a job this iteration published and committed (GD Created) -> GD_PICKING_OUTBOX_CONSUMER for its
// event. Only after this run's own publish call: a job skipped here may be another worker's, and a second consumer run
// on the same event dies on the consumer's claim gate. A consumer that fails leaves the event READY for its schedule.
const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
const guard = [{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data}}][0] || {};
const mid = [{{node:code_node_7UMUXQpd.data}}][0] || {};
const rows = [{{node:sql_node_PKjob001.data}}][0];
const job = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.id))[0] || null;
const gdId = job ? s(job.gd_id) : "";
let why = "";
if (s(guard.route) !== "CONTINUE") why = "guard " + s(guard.route);
else if (s(mid.route) !== "PUBLISH") why = "no publish call in this iteration";
else if (!job || String(job.is_deleted) !== "0") why = "job row not found";
else if (s(job.job_status) !== "GD_COMMITTED") why = "job is " + s(job.job_status);
else if (s(job.gd_status) !== "Created") why = "delivery is " + (s(job.gd_status) || "missing");
else if (!/^[0-9]{1,20}$/.test(gdId) || gdId === "0") why = "job has no gd_id";
const call = why === "";
console.log("worker picking", JSON.stringify({ job: s(mid.jobId), call: call, why: why }));
return { route: call ? "PICK" : "END", eventId: call ? "GD_COMMITTED|" + gdId + "|1" : "", jobId: job ? s(job.id) : s(mid.jobId), gdId: gdId, jobStatus: job ? s(job.job_status) : "", result_message: call ? "picking for GD " + gdId : why };

RESP: ['route', 'eventId', 'jobId', 'gdId', 'jobStatus', 'result_message']

       j.job_status,
       j.attempt_count,
       j.lease_owner,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,

         WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.tenantId}}'
           AND g.gd_dockey = (CONCAT('JOB|', CAST(j.id AS CHAR)) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
           AND g.is_deleted = 0
         LIMIT 1) AS gd_status
  FROM gd_async_job j

######## code_node_LdCyuBWM [code-node] Evidence DONE
// GD_ASYNC_WORKER - Evidence (DONE)
// Generated by scripts/build-gd-async.mjs from scripts/lib/gd-async.mjs (+ scripts/lib/gd-bulk.mjs) - edit there.
// Quartz-invoked (one disabled-by-default WorkflowJob row per tenant): drains up to 10 due jobs per tick in a loop
// (budget: no new job after 20 s of the run start). Ownership of a job = the CLAIM GATE: one add-node unique
// insert of gd_publish_step W0_CLAIM_<row_version> (a twin's insert fails and its run dies before it writes the
// job); the lease WRK|<nonce> is the liveness timer. Calls GD_BULK_PREPARE then GD_BULK_COMMIT through workflow nodes,
// maps every result from the job ROW (the callee's response is evidence only) and writes GD business rows never
// (gd_async_job + its own gd_publish_step rows only).
// The engine stores only nodes whose output a later node references (docs/lowcode/inventory-operation-v2/evidence/engine-probe-run-2026-09-30.md F11): this node references the
// decision node of every step of its path (their route fields only), and the return node returns it. The loop's
// inner decisions are never read from outside the loop: the job rows read back after it are the truth.
const workerResult = function workerResult(guard, plan, rows) {
  const s = (v) => (v === undefined || v === null ? "" : String(v)).trim();
  const list = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : rows ? [rows] : []).filter((r) => r && s(r.id));
  const byId = {};
  for (const r of list) byId[s(r.id)] = r;
  const jobs = (plan.items || []).map((it) => {
    const j = byId[it.jobId] || null;
    return { job_id: it.jobId, before: it.jobStatus, job_status: j ? s(j.job_status) : "", error_code: j ? s(j.error_code) : "", gd_id: j ? s(j.gd_id) : "", gd_status: j ? s(j.gd_status) : "", attempt_count: j ? s(j.attempt_count) : "", lease_owner: j ? s(j.lease_owner) : "" };
  });
  const first = jobs[0] || null;
  const route = guard.route === "REJECT" ? "REJECTED" : plan.route === "IDLE" ? "IDLE" : "WORKED";
  const firstRow = first ? byId[first.job_id] || null : null;
  return { worker_route: route, processed: String(jobs.length), jobs: JSON.stringify(jobs), job_id: first ? first.job_id : "", job_status: first ? first.job_status : "", result_code: firstRow && s(firstRow.error_code) ? s(firstRow.error_code) : s(guard.result_code), result_message: firstRow && s(firstRow.error_message) ? s(firstRow.error_message) : s(guard.result_message) || s(plan.result_message), gd_id: first ? first.gd_id : "", gd_status: first ? first.gd_status : "", attempt_count: first ? first.attempt_count : "", lease_owner: first ? first.lease_owner : "" };
};
const T = (v) => String(v === undefined || v === null ? "" : v).replace(/^"([\s\S]*)"$/, "$1").trim();
const steps = {};
steps.guard = T([{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data.route}}][0]);
steps.plan = T([{{node:code_node_JsJ91wA5.data.route}}][0]);
const guard = [{{node:code_node_1OvNTk9G.data}}][0];
const plan = [{{node:code_node_JsJ91wA5.data}}][0];
const rows = [{{node:sql_node_CObTsMBI.data}}][0] || [];
const r = workerResult(guard, plan, rows);
const evidence = { v: 1, workflow: "GD_ASYNC_WORKER", path: "DONE", steps: steps };
return Object.assign(r, { evidence: JSON.stringify(evidence) });

RESP: ['worker_route', 'processed', 'jobs', 'job_id', 'job_status', 'result_code', 'result_message', 'gd_id', 'gd_status', 'attempt_count', 'lease_owner', 'evidence']
